messages.author: ab78e227e394cf1d
messages.subject: Fixed hyperparameter in INLA
parts:
Hi INLA members,

Can we put a fixed hyper parameter for INLA?

I know different version of prior specification from INLA::inla.doc("table"). But is there any easy way to keep the hyperparameter for precision parameter fixed in besag model and evaluate all the random effects?

Alokesh.

messages.author: ab78e227e394cf1d
messages.subject: Re: Fixed hyperparameter in INLA
parts:
Hi INLA Members,

Also a follow up question.

if I want to use a fixed hyper parameter,

```
hyper=list(prec = list(prior = "loggamma",
                                                      param=c(1,.00005),
                                                      initial=log(3.704862e-02),
                                                      fixed=TRUE)
                               )

```

should it be same as assuming \tau=log(3.704862e-02) in besag model. 

Also, if I prespecify hyperparameter, will that be helpful for making faster model in case of more than 15 random component in INLA model? (we know that inla might have limitation of handling many hyper parameters as it optimize over grid search)

Alokesh.

messages.author: 9a89594e7fcb7aad
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Fixed hyperparameter in INLA
parts:
f(idx, model="iid",
hyper=list(prec = list(initial=log(1/a^2), fixed=TRUE)))

will keep the precision for the iid model FIXED to 1/a^2, ie a=STDEV

similar for all other hyperparmeters

messages.author: 9a89594e7fcb7aad
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Re: Fixed hyperparameter in INLA
parts:
the internal scale for precision is log(prec), hence setting

initial=a, fixed=TRUE

for precision, will use a fixed value for precision of

prec = exp(a)
